site.title: GCWM Play
site.tagline: Browser games and learning apps made in Singapore
site.intro: City builders, life sims, quizzes and party games. Everything here runs in the browser on a phone or a computer, with nothing to install.

projects.title: Lion City Mayor
projects.summary: Run one region of Singapore from 1965 for a century. Zone HDB estates, open MRT lines and hawker centres, balance the budget, and win elections while real crises arrive on their real dates.

projects.title: FLIT: Life & CPF
projects.summary: A Singapore life simulator from age 7 to 85. Study, work, buy a flat and raise a family, then see how your choices shape your CPF and retirement.

projects.title: Monsoon Merchants
projects.summary: Build the biggest store chain from Mumbai to Tokyo. Read each city's tastes, ride the festival calendar and beat three rival chains, solo or with friends.

projects.title: Lion City Planner
projects.summary: The original Singapore city builder. Draw roads and MRT lines, zone housing and industry, and secure the Four National Taps before imported water ends in 2061.

projects.title: Singapore P3 Math Quest
projects.summary: Endless practice across the Primary 3 maths syllabus, from place value to bar-model word problems, with streak targets, a mistake review book and a scratchpad.

projects.title: Colour Castle
projects.summary: See the world through someone else's eyes. Pick a type of colour blindness, find the right door, try dot tests, and learn the history behind it.

projects.title: AI Explorer
projects.summary: How AI really works, for P4 to P6. Follow a sentence through a language model, visit an AI factory and data centre, tour the model zoo, and finish with a quiz.

projects.title: Dino Dash Duel
projects.summary: A dino running game for up to four players on one device. Race, survive the endless run or grab the most coins, with split screens on phones and keyboards on computers.

projects.title: Lanternmaze: Duel in the Dark
projects.summary: A maze race where you only see what your lantern lights. Vespera and Kaida each get their own maze, matched for route length, dead ends and junctions. Play against the AI or a friend on one device.

projects.title: Dice Grid
projects.summary: Chess where every piece is a die. Pieces grow as they move and can only capture lower numbers. Play the computer, tweak the rules and run balance tests.

projects.title: Dice Grid Tactics
projects.summary: Dice Grid's mechanics on a tabletop wargame board, with pixel-art militia, cavalry, archers and siege towers fighting over a moat.

projects.title: Operation Board Briefing
projects.summary: A phone-based escape room for CPF Board induction. Teams crack ciphers, decode emails and rebuild two lost briefing slides before the President's visit.

projects.title: Tilt Maze
projects.summary: A side puzzle from the escape room: tilt your phone to roll a ball through a maze and retrieve the hint.

projects.title: Data Run
projects.summary: A side puzzle from the escape room: one teammate races a data point back from the far-away server room.

projects.title: Follow a Team
projects.summary: A spectator screen for the escape room. Enter a team's room code to watch its progress live.
